 by tele.net by tele.net 
 13 Nov 2026 10:28 IST
 Link copied! Copy failed! 
 Vodafone Idea Limited (Vi) has announced its consolidated financial results for the quarter ended (QE) September 30, 2026. The company's revenue from operations increased by 6.2 per cent year on year to Rs 118.84 billion in the second quarter (Q2) of financial year 2026-27 (FY27), compared to Rs 111.95 billion in Q2 FY26. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, revenue grew by 1.7 per cent from Rs 116.89 billion in Q1 FY27.
 Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) increased by 6.3 per cent year on year to Rs 49.81 billion from Rs 46.85 billion in Q2 FY26. Cash EBITDA (before Ind AS 116) rose by 11.2 per cent to Rs 24.98 billion from Rs 22.46 billion in the corresponding quarter last year. The cash EBITDA margin improved by 96 basis points to 21.0 per cent. Meanwhile, the company reported an adjusted loss of Rs 55.13 billion, compared to Rs 55.62 billion in Q2 FY26. Reported loss widened to Rs 59.75 billion from Rs 55.24 billion, primarily due to the adverse impact of mark-to-market valuation of treasury assets.
 Commenting on the performance, chief executive officer, Vi, said, “Our focus continues to remain firmly on execution. Our Q2 FY27 performance reflects steady progress against our priorities. We are encouraged by the continued improvement in our net subscriber additions, supported by our network expansion and enhanced customer experience. Building on these improvements, we strengthened our customer proposition through innovative, differentiated and industry-first propositions such as free international roaming and family prepaid plans. Our refreshed brand identity and related campaigns are resonating well with our subscribers. We have placed capital expenditure (capex) orders of over Rs 132 billion of which nearly Rs 60 billion capex has been executed. Encouraged by our progress in discussions to raise funding, we are confident to place additional orders and sustain the momentum in our network expansion.”
